title.narrative: FBF/2025/PEPY: Amplifying the impact of PEPY's

description.narrative: PEPY Empowering Youth is a local non-profit and NGO providing personal and professional development training to rural youth in Siem Reap, Cambodia, dedicated to helping individuals find pathways to success. Starting at the high school level, their programmes provide holistic support for young people to have the tools, network, and resources to succeed in school and thrive in the professional setting of their choice.The project aims to strengthen the long-term impact and sustainability of PEPY in community development through data-driven decision-making through the expansion, development and adoption of the unified Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) system which was developed under the grant of the Embassy in 2023. This project will enhance the organisational efficiency, decision-making, and impact measurement across all departments of PEPY.
